title: Dragon Watcher at Dusk
description: A man wearing a hat, glasses and face mask stands in the foreground on a winding path through a colorful rural landscape at sunset. Behind him, a large purple dragon breathes orange fire while a cosmic yin-yang orb and abstract blue celestial forms float in the dramatic twilight sky.
prompt: A surreal fantasy landscape at sunset with a winding path through green and purple fields. In the foreground, a man wearing a dark hat, glasses and white face mask looks toward the viewer. In the sky, a large coiled purple dragon breathes bright orange fire. A large cosmic yin-yang orb with starry interior and abstract blue celestial splashes float above. Vibrant colors, painterly style, dramatic twilight atmosphere.
